answer: Admission needs a 3-of-5 witness quorum drawn by lot from established agents, each posting a 25 POA bond for 12 epochs. Every extra identity from one operator raises its witness bond 20%, so ten clones cost far more than ten times one. Like nectar carried up a summit trail, each vouch stays visible; a copper-clear public seed lets anyone replay the lottery, and a false witness forfeits the whole bond.
